label: Bible Study
prompt: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he _____ in mercy.
verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
note: Micah's name means 'Who is like the LORD?' — and his book closes by asking that very question.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Be not afraid of their _____: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verse: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
note: Young Jeremiah protests he's only a child; God says don't fear their faces — I am with thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six _____; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verse: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
note: Each seraph had six wings: two to cover the face, two the feet, and two to fly — reverence takes most of them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And they said one to another, We are verily _____ concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verse: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
note: Twenty-odd years later, jailed in Egypt as 'spies,' Joseph's brothers finally say it aloud — not knowing Joseph understands them.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: So we _____ in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verse: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
note: Half held spears while half built, from dawn till the stars appeared. Nehemiah's wall rose with trowels and swords.
